_about: Real FreeWRL window captures. Source PNGs sit beside this file; scripts/make_captures.py writes the web copies. Never edit a capture by hand beyond resizing. macOS entries: "source" is the file in the capture package (PNG copied byte for byte; posters are frame 0 of the .mov, scaled to the clip size by scripts/make_macos_clips.sh); "crop" trims for presentation only.

linux-2026-10-01.label: FreeWRL 6.7.0 · Ubuntu 24.04
linux-2026-10-01.detail: FreeWRL 6.7.0 (libfreewrl 6.7.0), local autotools build of Ascendance3D/freewrl, built 2026-09-29. Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS, X11, NVIDIA RTX 3060 Ti, driver 595.91.07, OpenGL 4.6. Window captured with ImageMagick import on 2026-10-01; clip recorded with ffmpeg x11grab. Input from xdotool (mouse drag, Page Down).

macos-2026-10-02.label: FreeWRL 6.7.0 beta 2 · macOS, Apple Silicon
macos-2026-10-02.detail: FreeWRL 6.7.0 macOS Beta 2 (v6.7.0-macos-beta.2), the published notarized arm64 release, source commit 99415854db63. macOS 27.0.1 on an Apple M1, Retina display (2x). Captured with macOS screencapture on 2026-10-02; clips are re-encoded from the screencapture recordings. Real mouse and keyboard input.
